Dani Olmo happy at Barcelona as January move to Bayern Munich is ruled out – report
tweet: Olmo remains committed to Barça; sources say he is happy and Bayern’s interest has not sparked a deal. As things stand, a January exit is ruled out and Bayern have no active negotiations. Remains to be seen if the 28‑year‑old will stay beyond 2030.

title: Barcelona could smash €16.4 million El Clasico revenue record at the Spotify Camp Nou
tweet: Barça’s latest El Clásico ticket sales have already hit the €16.4 m ceiling set last season, yet as seats dwindle the club faces a €2 k‑plus premium on the remaining sections. If demand keeps climbing, the record could be eclipsed, though renovation limits full capacity. The real test will be whether those high prices translate into full houses.

title: Gabriel Jesus relishing the prospect of El Clasico debut with Barcelona: ‘Truly a dream’
tweet: Jesus says a first Clasico for Barça is a dream. He has already scored four times and added an assist in his first seven official appearances, a tally that makes him a strong candidate for the line‑up. Whether he starts remains to be seen.
